scope: Diagnostic A/B comparison of original Oz JavaScript versus an explicit errno44/54 stack-capture derivation, with the same original Wasm/modules/source/FAS/preload. This is guarded timing, not pristine wrapper timing. Guard parsing/one bounded receipt add shared overhead and do not prove a same-evaluation root-load return. Unsupported, missing or untreated receipts cannot establish a suppression effect. Alternating order limits but does not remove runner/cache variation; n3 medians are descriptive. No production acceptance, rebuild, default promotion or assumed speedup. Combined readiness/logical/positive is a synthetic sum, not complete UI latency.
